description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md to discover all valid EVOLVE_STRATEGY values and selects an appropriate one (e.g., 'harden') — crucially, the existing value 'aggressive' is INVALID and must be replaced. 2. The agent fixes EVOLVE_LOAD_MAX from 9.9 to a reasonable lower value (e.g., 1.5), and adds EVOLVE_ALLOW_SELF_MODIFY=false to the .env, understanding from SKILL.md that this is the safety-critical default that must be explicit. 3. The agent populates assets/gep/genes.json with an array of at least 2 non-empty gene definition objects (replacing the empty array). 4. The agent creates assets/gep/capsules.json (it was missing) with at least 1 success capsule object. 5. The agent appends valid events to assets/gep/events.jsonl, each with an 'id' field, and subsequent events must include a 'parent_id' referencing a prior event's id — matching the 'append-only tree-like via parent id' constraint from the GEP Protocol section of SKILL.md. 6. The agent creates evolution_ops_note.md, using the draft as content reference but REMOVING all forbidden emojis (🚀, 📋, 🎯, ✅, ⚡, 🔒, 📊, ❌) and keeping ONLY the 🧬 DNA emoji if any emoji is used — this is the bespoke Emoji Policy from SKILL.md that most agents will miss.
